description: Smart Mirror HD - 고화질 뷰티 & 메이크업 스마트 거울

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug

scripts.build:bundle: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew bundleRelease
